situations.desc_id: Wawancara kerja di Jepang, 19 skenario: salam, perkenalan diri, keluarga, alasan melamar, kelebihan & kekurangan, kesehatan, lembur, asrama, sampai penutup dan simulasi singkat.
situations.desc_en: Job interview in Japan, 19 scenarios: greeting, self-introduction, family, motivation, strengths & weaknesses, health, overtime, dormitory, closing and a mini mock interview.

situations.desc_id: 8 situasi di stasiun dan kereta: beli tiket, cari peron, transfer, kartu IC, barang tertinggal, kereta terlambat.
situations.desc_en: 8 situations at stations and on trains: buying tickets, finding platforms, transfers, IC cards, lost items, delays.

situations.desc_id: 8 situasi di konbini: beli bento, bayar, cari barang, fotokopi, kirim paket, bayar tagihan, kembalian salah, camilan panas.
situations.desc_en: 8 situations at a konbini: bento, paying, finding items, copying, sending parcels, paying bills, wrong change, hot snacks.

situations.desc_id: 10 situasi kerja di pabrik: pagi hari, penjelasan kerja, keselamatan, barang cacat, mesin rusak, izin, terlambat, cuti, dan pulang kerja.
situations.desc_en: 10 workplace situations at a factory: morning start, instructions, safety, defects, machine trouble, absences, lateness, leave, and clocking out.

situations.desc_id: 8 situasi di restoran: masuk & dapat meja, memesan, pantangan makanan, pesanan salah, minta rekomendasi, bayar, reservasi telepon, restoran cepat saji.
situations.desc_en: 8 restaurant situations: getting a table, ordering, food restrictions, wrong order, recommendations, paying, phone booking, fast food.

situations.desc_id: 8 situasi di rumah sakit: mendaftar, demam & batuk, sakit perut, alergi & pemeriksaan, apotek, ubah jadwal, memanggil ambulans, surat dokter.
situations.desc_en: 8 hospital situations: registering, fever and cough, stomach ache, allergies and tests, pharmacy, rescheduling, calling an ambulance, doctor's note.

situations.desc_id: 8 situasi lewat telepon: menelepon perusahaan, meninggalkan pesan, salah sambung, menerima telepon, paket ulang, menelepon pengelola, terlambat, suara tidak jelas.
situations.desc_en: 8 phone situations: calling a company, leaving a message, wrong number, answering a call, parcel re-delivery, calling the manager, running late, a bad line.

situations.desc_id: 8 situasi di supermarket: cari barang, bahan makanan & label halal, daging dan ikan, harga & diskon, kasir, barang habis, lauk siap saji, menyimpan makanan.
situations.desc_en: 8 supermarket situations: finding items, ingredients & halal labels, meat and fish, prices & discounts, the register, out-of-stock items, ready-made food, storing food.

situations.desc_id: 8 situasi di toko pakaian: mencari baju, ukuran (サイズ), warna, mencoba (試着), pas atau tidak, harga & obral, sepatu, tukar barang.
situations.desc_en: 8 clothing store situations: looking for clothes, sizes, colors, trying on (試着), fit, prices & sales, shoes, exchanges.

situations.desc_id: 7 situasi seputar gaji: hari gajian & rekening, membaca slip gaji, uang lembur, potongan, koreksi jam lembur, koreksi potongan ganda, gaji belum masuk.
situations.desc_en: 7 pay situations: payday & account, reading a payslip, overtime pay, deductions, correcting overtime hours, correcting a double deduction, pay not received.

situations.desc_id: 8 situasi kontrak ponsel dan internet: mulai kontrak, memilih paket, SIM card, cara bayar, bertanya tagihan, internet rumah, ponsel hilang, berhenti langganan.
situations.desc_en: 8 situations about phone and internet contracts: starting a contract, choosing a plan, SIM cards, payment, asking about bills, home internet, a lost phone, cancelling.

situations.desc_id: 8 situasi di bank: membuka rekening, PIN & buku tabungan, memakai ATM, kirim uang ke Indonesia (送金), tanya biaya & kurs, uang belum sampai, kartu ATM hilang, kartu tertelan.
situations.desc_en: 8 bank situations: opening an account, PIN & passbook, using an ATM, sending money to Indonesia (送金), fees & exchange rate, money not arrived, lost ATM card, card stuck.

situations.desc_id: 10 situasi di kantor kelurahan dan imigrasi: cari loket, lapor alamat, 住民票, mengisi formulir, kartu hilang, perpanjangan, pindah kerja, dan minta penjelasan sebelum tanda tangan.
situations.desc_en: 10 situations at city hall and immigration: finding the counter, address registration, 住民票, forms, a lost card, extensions, changing jobs, and asking for an explanation before signing.

situations.desc_id: 8 situasi tetangga dan asrama: menyapa tetangga baru, hari buang sampah, memilah sampah, minta maaf karena berisik, menegur dengan sopan, kunci hilang, terkunci di luar, mesin cuci bersama.
situations.desc_en: 8 neighbor and dorm situations: greeting neighbors, garbage days, sorting garbage, apologizing for noise, politely complaining, a lost key, being locked out, the shared washing machine.
